Pumpkins, Pies & Pals

Join the Explorer Buddy Club for Pumpkins, Pies & Pals! Spend the afternoon decorating cookies, painting mini pumpkins, and showing off your creativity in a pumpkin carving contest. Grab a slice of pumpkin pie, sip hot cocoa, take photos at our fall photo booth and make new friends along the way!

Time: 3:30 - 5:30 pm
